mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept common to many African communities."
Character is a concept common to many African communities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known among the Yoruba as Emi whereas the Nupe call it Rayi."
The breath is known among the Yoruba as Emi whereas the Nupe call it Rayi.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the deliberate appeal to metaphysical forces in the universe towards a chosen agenda."
Magic is the deliberate appeal to metaphysical forces in the universe towards a chosen agenda.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a repercussion for falling short of certain expectations."
Judgment refers to a repercussion for falling short of certain expectations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon that has interested the African over the years and for which explanations have been proffered based on the experiences of the African in the universe."
Creation is a phenomenon that has interested the African over the years and for which explanations have been proffered based on the experiences of the African in the universe.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the return of a dead ancestor in another body or by a body influenced by features of the ancestors."
Re-incarnation for Africans is the return of a dead ancestor in another body or by a body influenced by features of the ancestors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reality at the various institutions of learning in Africa."
The study of African Traditional Religion is a reality at the various institutions of learning in Africa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the "face" of divine power in the ritual setting."
The human agency is the "face" of divine power in the ritual setting.
